versions.changelog:
- Updated metadata to add OpenClaw integration details, including required binaries and homepage.
- Removed previous Media.io-specific metadata (emoji, publisher, source).
- No changes to functionality or endpoint usage.

Initial release of the Media.io AI Age Filter skill.

- Apply AI-powered age transformation filters (make a face look younger or older) using Media.io OpenAPI.
- Supports asynchronous task workflow: submit an image URL, poll the task result, and retrieve generated output URLs.
- Includes credit checking before generation and comprehensive error handling.
- Only accepts publicly accessible image URLs (no local file uploads).
- Provides clear guidance for expected API interactions, supported modes ("Older" or "Younger"), and safety compliance.
